title: Linguistic Generalizability of Test-Time Scaling in Mathematical Reasoning
authors_zh: Guijin Son、Jiwoo Hong、Hyunwoo Ko、James Thorne（机构：Yonsei University、OneLineAI、KAIST AI、MODULABS）
paper_type_zh: 多语言测试时扩展基准与比较研究（ACL 2025）
best_for_zh: 评估测试时扩展策略能否迁移到英语之外推理场景的读者。
one_line: MCLM tests outcome rewards, process rewards, and budget forcing at matched compute across 55 languages, exposing weak cross-lingual scaling gains.
MCLM 在 55 种语言中以匹配计算比较结果奖励、过程奖励和预算强制，揭示测试时扩展的跨语言收益很弱。
why: It shows that a gain measured only in English can overstate the generality of an inference-time scaling method.
inclusion_reason: It directly measures whether reward-guided and token-budget test-time scaling remains beneficial when the reasoning language changes.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Test-time scaling is usually evaluated in English, even though the same inference policy may be deployed in many reasoning languages. More candidates, a process reward model, or a longer chain can improve an English result while failing to improve a translated problem, increasing variance between languages, or consuming a different amount of compute because tokenization and generation length change. An English-only curve therefore cannot establish that the inference budget is generally effective.

This paper asks whether three common forms of additional test-time computation transfer across languages: outcome-reward-model selection, process-reward-model search, and budget forcing. The decision object is a mathematical problem expressed in one of 55 languages together with a generation, selection or continuation budget. The evaluation record keeps language, method, candidate or step count, tokens and inference FLOPs, answer, and consistency, allowing methods to be compared at matched compute rather than by unconstrained accuracy.

测试时扩展通常只在英语中评估，尽管同一推理策略可能被部署到多种推理语言中。更多候选、过程奖励模型或更长思维链可以改善英语结果，却可能无法改善翻译后的题目、增加语言间方差，或因分词和生成长度变化消耗不同计算。因此，只有英语的曲线不能证明这种推理预算具有普遍有效性。

本文研究三种常见的额外测试时计算能否跨语言迁移：结果奖励模型选择、过程奖励模型搜索和预算强制。决策对象是用 55 种语言之一表述的数学问题，以及生成、选择或继续预算。评估记录保留语言、方法、候选或步骤数、token 和推理 FLOPs、答案及一致性，使方法能够在匹配计算下比较，而不是按不受约束的准确率比较。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central idea is to treat language as a stress variable for inference scaling. MCLM supplies competition-level mathematical tasks in 55 languages, and the study subjects each method to an equivalent inference-FLOPs budget. Outcome reward modeling spends compute on multiple complete candidates and reranks them; process reward modeling spends it on stepwise branching and assessment; budget forcing spends it by allowing a reasoning model to generate longer. Equalizing cost prevents a method from appearing stronger merely because it ran a larger verifier or more decoding passes.

The paper also separates a method’s average gain from its linguistic reliability. A system that improves English but fails elsewhere is not linguistically general. The authors release MCLM, evaluation results, and MR1-1.5B, a multilingual reasoning model, to expose that distinction. The decisive record is thus a language-conditioned scaling trajectory: question, language, strategy and budget, generated trace or candidates, scoring path, final answer, and cross-language outcome distribution.

核心观点是把语言当作推理扩展的压力变量。MCLM 提供 55 种语言的竞赛级数学任务，研究让每种方法处于等价的推理 FLOPs 预算下。结果奖励模型把计算花在多个完整候选及重排序上；过程奖励模型把计算花在逐步分支和评估上；预算强制则让推理模型生成更长轨迹。成本对齐能避免某种方法只因运行了更大判分器或更多解码轮次而看起来更强。

论文还把方法的平均收益与语言可靠性分开。一个改善英语却在其他语言失败的系统，并不具备语言泛化性。作者发布 MCLM、评估结果和多语言推理模型 MR1-1.5B，以揭示这种区别。因此，决定性记录是一条语言条件化的扩展轨迹：问题、语言、策略与预算、生成轨迹或候选、评分路径、最终答案和跨语言结果分布。

title: Method
方法
html:
The study evaluates Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and 7B configurations and a multilingual MR1-1.5B model. For outcome rewards, it generates K candidates and chooses with a reward model; for process rewards, it varies generation steps and candidates per step; for budget forcing, it constrains the reasoning-token limit of MR1. The authors estimate generator cost from model size and generated tokens, incorporate verifier cost, and compare configurations at matched inference FLOPs. This accounting is central because outcome, process, and continuation methods otherwise hide different computational surfaces.

MCLM covers multiple mathematical subsets and 55 languages. The paper also trains MR1-related variants from R1-derived thinking trajectories, including translated-data configurations, then measures accuracy, language-level variance, and Fleiss’ kappa consistency. Reproduction should preserve the exact translation and language set, generator and verifier revisions, candidate and step schedules, budget-forcing delimiters, FLOPs formula, answer parser, and whether the result is a per-language average or a pooled score.

研究评估 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 与 7B 配置，以及多语言 MR1-1.5B 模型。对于结果奖励，它生成 K 个候选并用奖励模型选择；对于过程奖励，它改变生成步骤和每步候选数；对于预算强制，它约束 MR1 的推理 token 上限。作者根据模型规模和生成 token 估计生成器成本，纳入判分器成本，并在匹配的推理 FLOPs 下比较配置。这种成本统计是核心，因为结果、过程和继续生成方法原本隐藏了不同计算表面。

MCLM 覆盖多个数学子集和 55 种语言。论文还从 R1 衍生的思考轨迹训练 MR1 相关变体，包括翻译数据配置，并测量准确率、语言层面的方差和 Fleiss’ kappa 一致性。复现应保留精确的翻译与语言集合、生成器和判分器修订版、候选与步骤日程、预算强制分隔符、FLOPs 公式、答案解析器，以及结果是逐语言平均还是合并分数。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under matched inference FLOPs, the paper reports similar average performance for the tested scaling families: Qwen2.5-1.5B Math with outcome rewards scores 35.84 on MCLM, while budget forcing on MR1-1.5B scores 35.23. The result challenges a simple hierarchy in which a visible “thinking” model is assumed to dominate candidate sampling or reward-guided selection once all compute is counted.

The stronger result is the linguistic gap. Budget forcing improves English AIME by 20 points in the reported setting but supplies only a 1.94-point average gain across the other languages; the paper says the same weak transfer pattern appears for the other tested strategies, without improved variance or consistency. This evidence is deliberately diagnostic rather than a claim that scaling never helps: it shows that gains depend on language and difficulty, and that a multilingual average can conceal both improvements and regressions for particular language–method pairs.

在匹配推理 FLOPs 下，论文报告所测试扩展家族的平均表现相近：带结果奖励的 Qwen2.5-1.5B Math 在 MCLM 上为 35.84，而 MR1-1.5B 上的预算强制为 35.23。该结果挑战了一种简单层级，即一旦统计全部计算，不能假定可见“思考”模型总会支配候选采样或奖励引导选择。

更强的结果是语言差距。预算强制在报告设置中将英语 AIME 提高 20 分，却在其他语言上平均只带来 1.94 分收益；论文指出其他测试策略也出现相同的弱迁移模式，且没有改善方差或一致性。这些证据是诊断性的，而非宣称扩展从不有用：它表明收益依赖语言和难度，多语言平均值也可能掩盖特定语言—方法组合的改善与退化。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier test-time scaling evaluations largely ask whether additional samples, branches, or thinking tokens raise an aggregate benchmark score. This work changes the decision boundary by requiring that the answer hold across languages and under comparable inference cost. It places outcome rewards, process rewards, and budget forcing on one accounting surface, then examines whether each mechanism changes not just mean accuracy but the stability of reasoning behavior across language realizations of mathematical tasks.

The reusable novelty is the negative but actionable diagnostic: a scaling technique can be effective in English while remaining linguistically brittle. MCLM and the released multilingual model make this failure measurable rather than anecdotal. The work does not introduce a universal remedy for the gap; translated supervised data improves some reported results but does not make test-time scaling language invariant. Its contribution is a stronger evaluation contract for claiming general inference-time gains.

先前的测试时扩展评估主要询问额外样本、分支或思考 token 是否提高某个合并基准分数。本工作改变了决策边界，要求结论在多种语言和可比较的推理成本下仍成立。它把结果奖励、过程奖励和预算强制置于同一成本统计表面，再考察每种机制是否不仅改变平均准确率，还改变数学任务不同语言表述下推理行为的稳定性。

可复用的新意是一个消极但可操作的诊断：一种扩展技术可以在英语中有效，却在语言上脆弱。MCLM 和发布的多语言模型使这种失败可测量，而不是轶事。该工作没有为差距提出通用补救；翻译监督数据改善了一些报告结果，却未让测试时扩展对语言保持不变。其贡献是为宣称普遍的推理时收益建立更强的评估契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The study focuses on mathematical reasoning and primarily smaller models, so its language-generalization diagnosis may not transfer unchanged to code, agents, or larger proprietary systems. MCLM translations and answer parsing can introduce language-specific artifacts, while FLOPs matching does not capture every practical cost of different generators, reward models, or tokenizers. The findings also depend on the tested 55-language distribution and selected methods. A deployment should therefore test its own language mix, verifier reliability, script and formatting effects, and per-language latency before treating an English scaling curve as evidence of multilingual robustness.
研究聚焦数学推理并主要使用较小模型，因此其语言泛化诊断未必能原样迁移到代码、智能体或更大的专有系统。MCLM 翻译和答案解析可能引入语言特定伪影，而 FLOPs 匹配也无法覆盖不同生成器、奖励模型或分词器的所有实际成本。发现还依赖测试的 55 种语言分布和选定方法。因此，部署应测试自身的语言混合、判定器可靠性、文字系统和格式效应，以及逐语言延迟，不能把英语扩展曲线当作多语言鲁棒性的证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when deciding whether a test-time budget policy is safe to ship in several languages. Report language-stratified accuracy, variance, consistency, candidate count, branch width and depth, reasoning tokens, generator and verifier FLOPs, answer extraction success, wall-clock latency, and price. Compare strategies at matched total cost and inspect every language rather than only a macro average. MCLM is particularly useful as a regression suite for a policy that is developed in English but expected to serve multilingual mathematics, because it makes a lack of transfer visible before the policy is generalized by assumption.
当需要决定一种测试时预算策略能否安全地在多种语言中部署时，本工作很有用。应报告按语言分层的准确率、方差、一致性、候选数、分支宽度与深度、推理 token、生成器和判分器 FLOPs、答案提取成功率、实际运行延迟和价格。策略应在匹配总成本下比较，并检查每种语言而非只看宏平均。对于在英语中开发却预期服务多语言数学的策略，MCLM 特别适合作为回归测试集，因为它能在被默认泛化之前让迁移失败显现出来。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper as an evaluation correction to optimistic scaling claims. Start with its FLOPs accounting, because the comparison among outcome rewards, process rewards, and budget forcing is meaningful only after verifier and generator cost are both counted. Then contrast English gains with per-language gains and consistency. The key lesson is not that one strategy wins, but that method selection and token allocation must be evaluated on the language distribution that will actually be served. The released model and benchmark support that check, while the multilingual failure cases are as informative as the average score.
应把论文读作对乐观扩展主张的评估修正。先看其 FLOPs 统计，因为只有生成器和判分器成本都被计入后，结果奖励、过程奖励和预算强制之间的比较才有意义。随后把英语收益与逐语言收益和一致性进行对照。关键教训不是哪一种策略获胜，而是方法选择和 token 分配必须在实际将要服务的语言分布上评估。发布的模型和基准支持这种检查，而多语言失败案例与平均分数同样具有信息量。
